# PlexusOne - llms.txt
# This file helps AI assistants understand our project.
# Learn more: https://llmstxt.org/

# About
PlexusOne is an open source Go platform for building, running, and shipping AI-native software.
It has five areas: Agents, Systems, Operations, Specs, and the PlexusOne App.
Each project's page shows its maturity: in use today, active development, or early preview.

# Agents (build)
AI agents in Go, built from single-purpose Omni modules. Each module puts a provider-neutral interface in front of one capability, so providers can be swapped without code changes.

- OmniAgent: production AI agent framework that composes the Omni modules. https://github.com/plexusone/omniagent
- OmniLLM: multi-provider LLM abstraction with streaming, tool calling, and observability hooks. https://github.com/plexusone/omnillm
- OmniVoice: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice agents, and telephony. https://github.com/plexusone/omnivoice
- OmniChat: conversations over SMS, email, and chat channels. https://github.com/plexusone/omnichat
- OmniSERP: web, news, image, and video search behind one interface. https://github.com/plexusone/omniserp
- OmniObserve: send LLM traces to Opik, Langfuse, or Phoenix. https://github.com/plexusone/omniobserve
- OmniVault: multi-provider secret management. https://github.com/plexusone/omnivault
- AgentKit: reusable agent components. https://github.com/plexusone/agentkit
- AssistantKit: generates plugins for AI coding assistants from one agent definition. https://github.com/plexusone/assistantkit
- W3Pilot: browser automation for agents, with an MCP server. https://github.com/plexusone/w3pilot
- Agent teams: agent-team-release, agent-team-stats, agent-team-prd, agent-code-review, agent-a11y, agentsentinel. https://plexusone.dev/agents

# Systems (run)
SystemForge is a batteries-included Go platform module for multi-tenant SaaS: identity, sessions, an OAuth 2.0/OIDC server, authorization (RBAC and ReBAC), feature flags, and PostgreSQL row-level security. It can host many apps in one server or federate separate services to one sign-in.

- SystemForge: https://github.com/plexusone/systemforge
- SystemForge Web: React packages for SaaS front ends that work with SystemForge. https://github.com/plexusone/systemforge-web
- ConnectForge: tenant connections to external services; callers never handle raw secrets. Early. https://github.com/plexusone/connectforge
- PayForge: billing runtime driven by a pricing spec. Early. https://github.com/plexusone/payforge
- KeyForge: envelope encryption and key lifecycle for Go. Early. https://github.com/plexusone/keyforge

# Operations (ship)
Policy-driven automation across GitHub organizations, using Cedar policy-as-code. Early preview.

- VersionConductor: dependency PR automation and maintenance releases. https://github.com/plexusone/versionconductor
- PipelineConductor: keeps CI/CD pipelines consistent and reports drift. https://github.com/plexusone/pipelineconductor

# Specs (foundation)
Open, machine-readable specifications that drive generation, linting, diagrams, and agent instructions.

- SystemSpec Architecture: architecture as a typed graph. https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-architecture
- SystemSpec Design System: design systems as code. https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-designsystem
- SystemSpec API Style: one API style definition, many enforcers. https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-apistyle
- SystemSpec Pricing & Packaging: pricing as a source of truth. https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-pricingpackaging
- SystemSpec Deploy: deployment topology as a graph. https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-deploy
- Multi-Agent Spec: define agent teams once, deploy anywhere. https://github.com/plexusone/multi-agent-spec
- Structured Evaluation: standard reports for LLM-as-judge. https://github.com/plexusone/structured-evaluation

# PlexusOne App
PlexusOne Desktop is a native macOS workbench for running many AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, side by side in tmux-backed terminal panes. It tracks every Claude Code session, alerts you when one is waiting, and restores sessions after a crash.

- PlexusOne App: https://github.com/plexusone/plexusone-app
- AgentPair: agent-to-agent pair programming. https://github.com/plexusone/agentpair
- AgentComms: MCP plugin that calls or messages you when an AI coding assistant needs you. https://github.com/plexusone/agentcomms

# Key Concepts
- Core projects are written in Go; SystemForge Web is React and TypeScript, and the macOS app is Swift
- Small independent modules by default; integrated only where parts must share identity and tenancy
- No vendor lock-in: swap providers without code changes
- Specs are Go-first: Go types are the source of truth and JSON Schemas are generated from them
- Open source under permissive licenses
